data.title: Teens arrested for assaulting and robbing Japanese tourist
data.description: Seven youths, between the ages of 13 and 17, were arrested on Thursday night for allegedly robbing and assaulting a Japanese tourist, who was lost near Makkasan Airport Rail Link station. The suspects told police they attacked the tourist with their fists to rob 1,400 baht.

data.title: QR case hearing on Aug 26
data.description: <p>The Constitutional Court has scheduled a witness hearing for Aug 26 in a case concerning the use of barcodes and QR codes on ballot papers in the Feb 8 general election.</p>

data.title: DLA opens score review for local govt candidates
data.description: <p>Candidates in the 2025 local government recruitment examination can review their scores from now until the end of the month, acting Department of Local Administration (DLA) director-general Nirat Pongsitthaworn said yesterday.</p>

data.title: Firms to design two new routes
data.description: <p>The State Railway of Thailand (SRT) board has approved consultancy contracts worth a combined 392.8 million baht to design two new railway projects linking the North and Northeast, with the contracts expected to be signed in September.</p>

data.title: Govt to host 29th ALMM
data.description: <p>Thailand will host the 29th Asean Labour Ministers Meeting (ALMM) from Aug 23-28 at the Dusit Thani Bangkok, focusing on internationally recognised skills certification to prepare the region's workforce for the digital and green economies and an ageing society.</p>

data.title: Dept warns of fake Lampang bowls
data.description: <p>The Department of Intellectual Property has warned consumers about widely sold fake Rooster-brand ceramic bowls native to Lampang in the northern region, citing the product's geographical indication (GI) protection.</p>

data.title: Chaichanok faces TH-AI subpoena
data.description: <p>The House budget monitoring committee may compel Digital Economy and Society Minister Chaichanok Chidchob to testify over the TH-AI Passport project after he failed to appear before the panel for a fourth time.</p>

data.title: House panel targets alleged Thai citizenship fraud
data.description: A House committee has urged authorities to dismantle a suspected transnational network that allegedly used Thai men as fake fathers to help children born to Chinese parents fraudulently obtain Thai citizenship.

data.title: Chaichana reports to police over 'assault'
data.description: Democrat Party deputy leader and Nakhon Si Thammarat MP Chaichana Detdecho reported to police on Thursday to acknowledge an assault charge and give a statement over an alleged physical confrontation with a senior police officer at a funeral.

data.title: US agrees to boost defence cooperation
data.description: <p>Thailand and the United States have reaffirmed their 193-year alliance, underscoring their commitment to strengthening modern security cooperation to address emerging security challenges.</p>

data.title: Japanese tourist injured in robbery near Bangkok Airport Rail Link station
data.description: A 43-year-old Japanese tourist was injured by a group of suspected robbers near Makkasan station on the Bangkok Airport Rail Link on Wednesday night, police said.

data.title: Household power bills to fall from Sept 1
data.description: Household electricity bills have been poised to fall from September after regulators approved a new tariff structure that removes public street-lighting costs from residential bills and caps the rate for the first 200 units of monthly consumption at no more than 3 baht per unit.

data.title: ERC confirms lower power bills from Sep
data.description: Household electricity bills have been poisted to fall from September after regulators approved a new tariff structure that removes public street-lighting costs from residential bills and caps the rate for the first 200 units of monthly consumption at no more than 3 baht per unit.

data.title: Policeman caught smoking meth during online training
data.description: PHATTHALUNG: An investigation has been launched after a police officer was allegedly caught using methamphetamine during an online training session attended by hundreds of fellow officers.

data.title: Cobra Gold 2027 ‘to proceed as planned’
data.description: Thailand and the United States will proceed with the Cobra Gold 2027 military exercises according to the original plan, a spokesman for the Ministry of Defence said on Thursday.

data.title: Court acquits actress Pinky in Forex-3D Ponzi case
data.description: The Criminal Court on Thursday acquitted actress Savika “Pinky” Chaiyadej, her mother and her elder brother in the high-profile Forex-3D investment fraud case, while sentencing Forex-3D founder Apiruk Kothi and four other defendants to lengthy prison terms.

data.title: Israeli envoy seeks closer ties in Surat Thani
data.description: SURAT THANI - Alona Fisher-Kamm, the Israeli ambassador to Thailand, on Thursday reaffirmed cooperation with local authorities on tourism, business and public safety issues involving the southern province’s growing Israeli community.

data.title: Thailand seizes more assets of Chinese tycoon Chen Zhi
data.description: Thailand is moving to confiscate another 115 million baht in assets linked to the Chinese-Cambodian tycoon Chen Zhi, who is now awaiting trial in China for financial crimes.

data.title: Korean drug and fraud fugitive arrested in Phuket
data.description: PHUKET - A South Korean fugitive accused of drug trafficking and fraud was arrested in this island province on Wednesday, after overstaying his Thai visa for more than eight years.

data.title: Raid nets thousands of illegally imported Japanese products
data.description: More than 83,000 items of illegally imported Japanese skincare and household product brands, worth 8.3 million baht, have been seized at a warehouse in Samut Prakan, consumer protection police said on Thursday.

data.title: Gun prize giveaway prompts policy change
data.description: An event in which public officials on Koh Phangan received shotguns as draw prizes will be the last of its kind, a senior Interior Ministry official said on Thursday.

data.title: Rising Mekong closely watched as rain persists
data.description: Weather forecasters are paying very close attention to the rising water level of the Mekong River, which increases the flood risk in northern provinces nearby.

data.title: Six injured in knife and shotgun attack at fair
data.description: NAKHON RATCHASIMA - Motorcycle theft suspects attacked people with a shotgun and knife at a fair in Dan Khun Thot district of this northeastern province late Wednesday night. An arrested assailant said his group had been unfairly accused of bike theft.

data.title: Malaysian traveller dies during Bangkok airport transit
data.description: A Malaysian passenger collapsed and later died of a heart attack during a transit at Suvarnabhumi Airport, Bernama reported on Wednesday.

data.title: Government-wide password resets ordered after data leak
data.description: <p>The government has ordered staff of more than 300 departments to reset passwords immediately and inspect 30,000 systems to prevent further state data leaks.</p>

data.title: Businesses welcome drive against red tape
data.description: The private sector has welcomed the government's accelerating efforts to remove laws and regulations that hamper business, saying the initiative would sharpen the country's competitiveness.

data.title: Flood risks push up southern double-track rail budget
data.description: The State Railway of Thailand (SRT) has raised the budget for its southern double-track railway projects by 17% after flood risks and construction costs increased.

data.title: Blue plates for EVs ‘to aid emergency response’
data.description: The Ministry of Transport will introduce blue number plates for electric vehicles by the end of this year, with the colour intended to improve emergency response.

data.title: People’s Party takes flak over handling of abuse
data.description: Activists working to combat gender-based violence have called on the People's Party (PP) to apologise to former MP Tisana Choonhavan over its handling of her sexual abuse allegations and launch an independent investigation into the case.

data.title: Firms welcome govt bid to scrap red tape
data.description: The private sector has welcomed the government's accelerating efforts to remove laws and regulations that hamper business, saying the initiative would sharpen the country's competitiveness.

data.title: Missing German man found dead
data.description: PHUKET: The body of a 30-year-old German tourist who went missing after being swept out to sea at Freedom Beach has been found.

data.title: Lion café probed over bitten tourist
data.description: PHUKET: The Tourist Assistance Centre (TAC) has inspected a lion café following social media reports that a Chinese tourist was bitten by a lion.
